capabilities.name: PolicyScna Capability Control Plane
capabilities.responsibility: Govern stable capability identity, semantic ownership, lifecycle and reuse policy, then reconcile those claims continuously against repository-derived structure.
capabilities.authority_role: Repository architecture-memory integrity control; it does not decide insurance truth or runtime answer content.
safety_invariants: Derivable repository facts are verified from the tree rather than trusted as parallel catalog data.
NEW capability classification is never inferred merely from absence of an exact vocabulary match.
The catalog remains descriptive and must not carry roadmap or next-action authority.
Strict unregistered-capability enforcement may be enabled only after the governed census is reconciled.
The control plane is subject to its own scanner and validation rules.
capabilities.notes: STRICT enforcement is enabled after reconciliation reached zero unclaimed governed insurance_intelligence files.

capabilities.name: Assertion and Advisory Request Authority Boundary
capabilities.responsibility: Classify the authority a request asks PolicyScna to exercise independently of intent, including ASSERTIVE, ADVISORY, MIXED and UNRESOLVED authority.
capabilities.authority_role: Raises advisory safety obligations and clarification holds; it may never authorize recommendations or suppress independent intent analysis.
safety_invariants: UNRESOLVED authority retains an advisory hold rather than defaulting to ASSERTIVE.
Recommendation authorization remains false for every authority class.
Authority classification is independent of intent classification.
capabilities.notes: Deterministic v1 boundary over request text.

capabilities.name: Authority and Intent Reconciliation
capabilities.responsibility: Reconcile independent request-authority and intent outputs monotonically so intent may raise the guard but never lower an authority obligation.
capabilities.authority_role: Computes the minimum downstream guard and ordinary-assertion eligibility while preserving clarification and out-of-scope exits.
safety_invariants: Intent may raise the authority guard but may never lower it.
RECOMMENDATION and SUITABILITY_ASSESSMENT are advisory intent signals in v1.
Recommendation authorization remains false.
capabilities.notes: Comparison intents are not intrinsically advisory.

capabilities.name: Governed Context Builder
capabilities.responsibility: Build intent-keyed request context, provenance, missing-context state, assumptions, conflicts and answerability without asserting authoritative product, policy or document identity.
capabilities.authority_role: Determines context sufficiency only; textual mentions and candidate references do not establish governed insurance identity.
safety_invariants: Context completeness is distinct from authoritative instance identity.
A mention is not an identity.
Context requirements remain governed by intent rather than ad-hoc caller rules.
capabilities.notes: Identity/currentness resolution is intentionally outside this capability.

capabilities.name: Instance Sufficiency Guard
capabilities.responsibility: Require governed product, policy or document identity attestations before instance-specific planning can proceed.
capabilities.authority_role: Blocks planning when required instance identity is missing, ambiguous, unresolved or not bound to active context.
safety_invariants: Resolved instance attestations require canonical identity and immutable identity record references.
Non-resolved attestations may not carry authoritative identity fields.
Planning authorization is permitted only for PASS.
capabilities.notes: Reuses governed identity attestations rather than duplicating Knowledge Factory identity resolution.

capabilities.name: Evidence Instance Enforcement
capabilities.responsibility: Prevent the existing evidence resolver from running until Instance Sufficiency has passed for the request.
capabilities.authority_role: Preflight wrapper around evidence resolution; it cannot manufacture evidence or identity.
safety_invariants: Evidence resolution is not called when Instance Sufficiency is blocked.
Authorized evidence resolution requires a PASS instance-sufficiency result.
The wrapper delegates to the existing MO-016 resolver rather than replacing it.
capabilities.notes: Closes the direct-call bypass from textual/candidate instance references into evidence resolution.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Reasoning Engine
capabilities.responsibility: Derive registered insurance findings from governed evidence using deterministic finding types, derivation types, rules and evidence-sufficiency constraints.
capabilities.authority_role: May emit only registered finding types and derivations; it does not authorize recommendation or suitability outcomes.
safety_invariants: Unregistered finding types fail closed.
Missing, unresolved, conflicting or failed-lineage evidence blocks reasoning as governed.
Recommendation and suitability are not reasoning finding types.
capabilities.notes: PARTIAL evidence may support intentionally weaker reasoning where the governed rules allow it.

capabilities.name: Authority-Enforced Decision Gate
capabilities.responsibility: Enforce reconciled authority posture before delegating an eligible ordinary assertive request to the existing deterministic Decision and Safety Gate.
capabilities.authority_role: Withholds advisory, mixed, unresolved-authority, clarification and out-of-scope paths before the legacy Decision Gate can be invoked.
safety_invariants: Only the ordinary assertive path may delegate to the existing Decision Gate in v1.
Advisory safety obligations cannot coexist with ordinary assertion permission.
Recommendation authorization remains false.
capabilities.notes: A wrapper, not a rewrite of the proven Decision/Safety Gate.

capabilities.name: Authority-Enforced Explanation Entry
capabilities.responsibility: Prevent raw Decision Gate output from entering explanation generation unless authority enforcement has explicitly cleared the ordinary assertive path.
capabilities.authority_role: Controls entry into the existing evidence-locked Explanation Generator; it does not add findings or recommendation authority.
safety_invariants: Explanation requires a delegated AuthorityEnforcementResult with a preserved Decision Gate output.
Advisory safety obligations cannot enter the ordinary explanation path.
Recommendation authorization is prohibited.
capabilities.notes: Legacy Explanation Generator remains unchanged for historical compatibility.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Response Assembler
capabilities.responsibility: Assemble validated explanation content into deterministic response sections while preserving approved finding, evidence, limitation, assumption and clarification lineage.
capabilities.authority_role: Creates the deterministic deliverable answer baseline; it does not authorize new facts or LLM-originated content.
safety_invariants: Included finding-backed sections preserve evidence references.
Clarification identifiers remain bound to clarification sections.
The assembled response is the safe fallback floor for optional rendering.
capabilities.notes: Section-level lineage is preserved; finer render-unit mapping is owned by Rendering Exit Safety.

capabilities.name: Canonical Guarded Full-Cycle Orchestration Order
capabilities.responsibility: Define and enforce the canonical Intelligence response stage order so authority, instance, evidence, decision and explanation guards cannot be bypassed by orchestration assembly.
capabilities.authority_role: Structural ordering authority for full-cycle orchestration; guarded stages own delegation to legacy evidence, decision and explanation components.
safety_invariants: Authority classification and intent analysis both occur before reconciliation.
Instance Sufficiency occurs before planning and evidence resolution.
Evidence, Decision Gate and Explanation use guarded top-level stages without duplicate unguarded stages after them.
capabilities.notes: This proves canonical ordering, not by itself concrete production adapter wiring for every stage.

capabilities.name: Rendering Exit Safety
capabilities.responsibility: Project deterministic response sections into canonical render units and enforce bidirectional commission and omission conformance before rendered text may be released.
capabilities.authority_role: Final deterministic release authority over optional rendered candidates; failed candidates fall back to the original ResponseAssemblerOutput.
safety_invariants: Every v1 render unit is required.
Every v1 render unit uses PRESERVE_EXACT.
Unauthorized additions, required omissions, rewrites, ordering changes and identity mismatches fail closed.
The original assembler response remains available after every failure.
capabilities.notes: Does not claim that tagged arbitrary paraphrase is semantically conformant.

capabilities.name: Rendering Provider Integration Bridge
capabilities.responsibility: Reuse the existing MO-022 provider invocation stack while preserving provider omissions, additions and rewrites for final evaluation by Rendering Exit Safety.
capabilities.authority_role: Candidate-production bridge only; provider success and legacy fidelity success are insufficient for release without exit-safety PASS.
safety_invariants: No parallel provider protocol is introduced.
Unsafe provider output is not normalized away during bridge conversion.
Rendering Exit Safety remains the final release authority.
Provider failure, timeout, malformed output or conformance failure preserves the assembler fallback.
capabilities.notes: Vendor-specific production model adapters are not owned by this bridge.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Intent Analyzer
capabilities.responsibility: Classify normalized user requests into the governed Insurance Intelligence intent taxonomy, detect bounded follow-up/ambiguity signals, and emit deterministic intent-analysis output without establishing insurance facts or governed identity.
capabilities.authority_role: Request interpretation only; it does not establish authoritative insurance facts, resolve governed identity, retrieve evidence, reason about policy meaning, or authorize advisory outcomes.
safety_invariants: Intent classification remains independent from request-authority classification.
Candidate entity mentions are not governed identity assertions.
The governed intent taxonomy is reused rather than replaced by downstream planning or orchestration.
capabilities.notes: Current canonical orchestration runs this independently of request-authority classification before authority-intent reconciliation.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Reasoning Planner
capabilities.responsibility: Transform validated intent and context outputs into an explicit deterministic execution plan declaring required steps, evidence, calculations, capabilities, limitations, and stop conditions without performing those operations.
capabilities.authority_role: Planning authority only; it may declare required operations but does not retrieve evidence, calculate, interpret clauses, compare products, assess suitability, recommend, or generate answers.
safety_invariants: Instance-specific planning in the canonical guarded path occurs only after Instance Sufficiency PASS.
Planner stop conditions preserve missing context and unresolved conflicts rather than silently assuming them away.
A declared recommendation or suitability plan does not itself authorize recommendation or suitability output.
capabilities.notes: The planner remains a reusable declaration layer; advisory authority is governed independently upstream and downstream.

capabilities.name: Governed Evidence Resolver
capabilities.responsibility: Resolve planner evidence requirements against governed registry-backed sources, package evidence with authority/currentness/lineage metadata, and compute deterministic evidence sufficiency without interpreting policy meaning.
capabilities.authority_role: Underlying evidence-resolution engine. In the canonical current path it is callable only through II.EVIDENCE.INSTANCE_ENFORCEMENT when instance identity is required; it cannot manufacture identity or bypass that guard.
safety_invariants: Evidence packages preserve source lineage and authority requirements.
Unresolved entity, version, authority, or lineage conditions remain explicit in requirement results and sufficiency.
The current guarded orchestration must not call this resolver directly when Instance Sufficiency is required.
capabilities.notes: The later instance-enforcement wrapper constrains entry; it does not replace this resolver.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Decision and Safety Gate
capabilities.responsibility: Evaluate structured reasoning findings against deterministic safety policies, withhold unsafe findings, request clarification or human review when governed rules require it, and assemble an evidence-locked approved response packet.
capabilities.authority_role: Underlying deterministic safety-decision engine. In the current canonical path ordinary assertion access is mediated by II.DECISION.AUTHORITY_ENFORCEMENT; this base gate does not independently authorize advisory or recommendation paths.
safety_invariants: Only evidence-linked structured reasoning findings are eligible for approval.
Safety policies deterministically withhold, clarify, or escalate rather than silently weakening restrictions.
Current orchestration must not use this base gate to bypass reconciled authority enforcement.
capabilities.notes: Authority enforcement is a wrapper around this proven gate, not a replacement implementation.

capabilities.name: Evidence-Locked Explanation Generator
capabilities.responsibility: Render deterministic presentation sections from an already approved Decision Gate packet and fidelity-check those sections against approved findings, conditions, limitations, evidence, and communication scope.
capabilities.authority_role: Underlying presentation engine only. Current ordinary-assertion entry is mediated by II.EXPLANATION.AUTHORITY_ENFORCEMENT; the generator may not retrieve evidence, reason, alter approved scope, or add recommendation authority.
safety_invariants: Explanation is presentation-only and cannot create new governed findings.
Fidelity failure withholds generated sections rather than releasing altered meaning.
Current orchestration must not feed raw unguarded Decision Gate output into this generator.
capabilities.notes: The later authority-enforced explanation entry constrains invocation; it does not supersede this deterministic generator.

capabilities.name: Governed Full-Cycle Execution Runtime
capabilities.responsibility: Execute governed knowledge-build and intelligence-response stage adapters in the canonical requested order, normalize stage failures/blocks, preserve execution state and trace, and assemble full-cycle execution results.
capabilities.authority_role: Execution coordinator only; stage-order authority remains II.ORCHESTRATION.CANONICAL_GUARDED_ORDER and semantic authority remains with each guarded stage capability.
safety_invariants: Adapters must exactly match the governed stage order declared by the full-cycle contract.
A failed stage blocks dependent later stages rather than being skipped silently.
Orchestration normalizes execution and lineage but may not reinterpret or weaken a guarded stage decision.
capabilities.notes: This record intentionally excludes pilot/certification/hardening modules that still require separate census classification. Production USER_ANSWER evidence-stage composition is owned here and delegates semantic evidence authority to II.EVIDENCE.GOVERNED_RESOLVER.
